quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fermented food subscription box featuring rare probiotic products from around the world.
quests.correctAnswer: Kimchi, kefir, and kvass from six continents land on your doorstep monthly, turning gut health into a genuine monthly discovery.
quests.hint: Lead with the global variety and the gut health angle together.
quests.explanation: Pairing global variety with a health credential gives this subscription a premium position in a growing market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a co-parenting app that keeps custody schedules, expenses, and messages in one shared, neutral space.
quests.correctAnswer: Every schedule, expense, and message lives in one shared space, so co-parenting runs on facts instead of another difficult phone call.
quests.hint: Focus on replacing conflict with a calm, shared record.
quests.explanation: Replacing a difficult conversation with a neutral shared record lowers tension for both parents and, ultimately, the child.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a personal finance app that shows the real hourly cost of an impulse purchase before you buy it.
quests.correctAnswer: Before you buy, it shows exactly how many work hours that purchase actually costs - a number that's surprisingly hard to ignore.
quests.hint: Turn an abstract price into something felt immediately.
quests.explanation: Converting money into hours worked turns an abstract number into something felt immediately, right at the moment of temptation.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a meal-kit service that teaches restaurant-level techniques for home cooking.
quests.correctAnswer: Learn to blanch, brine, and sear the way a real kitchen does, so a weeknight dinner finally tastes like it came from one.
quests.hint: Lead with the technique being taught, not just the ingredients delivered.
quests.explanation: Teaching real technique, not just supplying ingredients, positions the kit as genuine education, not a shortcut.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home renovation app that shows a photo-realistic preview of any room before any work begins.
quests.correctAnswer: See the finished room, photo-realistic, before a single wall is touched - no more hoping the colour looks right after it's already painted.
quests.hint: Focus on removing the guesswork before spending any money.
quests.explanation: Removing pre-purchase guesswork is the single strongest way to reduce anxiety about any home renovation decision.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a personal chef booking platform for mid-week dinner parties that handles everything, cooking to washing up.
quests.correctAnswer: The shopping's done, the cooking's done, and even the washing-up is done - your dinner party, hosted by someone else entirely.
quests.hint: Walk through the entire chore list being removed.
quests.explanation: Listing the full chore list, start to finish, makes total convenience feel concrete rather than vague.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a restaurant booking system that eliminates no-shows using small, refundable deposits.
quests.correctAnswer: A small refundable deposit at booking means the table stays yours - and the restaurant's, too, since no-shows simply disappear.
quests.hint: Lead with the win for both the diner and the restaurant.
quests.explanation: Aligning the interests of both the customer and the business is an elegant, efficient pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a shared custody calendar app that flags scheduling conflicts between two households automatically.
quests.correctAnswer: The moment two households try to book the same weekend, it flags the clash instantly, before anyone shows up to an empty house.
quests.hint: Focus on catching the clash early, not after it happens.
quests.explanation: Catching a conflict before it happens prevents a stressful, avoidable situation for everyone involved.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a ghost kitchen platform that runs several delivery-only food brands from one shared kitchen space.
quests.correctAnswer: One kitchen quietly runs three different delivery brands at once, squeezing far more revenue out of every square metre of space.
quests.hint: Lead with revenue per square metre as the core case.
quests.explanation: Revenue per square metre is the exact financial argument that makes a ghost kitchen investment worth backing.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a marketplace connecting chefs directly with small regenerative farms for fully traceable ingredients.
quests.correctAnswer: Chefs order straight from the farm, and every ingredient carries its full story - who grew it, how, and where.
quests.hint: Lead with the chef's direct access and the story behind each ingredient.
quests.explanation: A traceable story behind every ingredient gives chefs something genuine to tell their own guests.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital estate-planning app that guides ordinary families through writing a will in one afternoon.
quests.correctAnswer: One guided afternoon, and a will that once felt overwhelming is finally, properly done - no law firm appointment required.
quests.hint: Focus on removing the intimidation, not the legal detail.
quests.explanation: Removing intimidation is often the real barrier to a task people know they should do but keep avoiding.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a spice supply platform linking smallholder farmers directly to food brands with full price transparency.
quests.correctAnswer: Brands see exactly where each spice came from, and the farmer who grew it is paid fairly, with no hidden middlemen in between.
quests.hint: Lead with the dual benefit: traceability for brands, fair pay for farmers.
quests.explanation: A dual benefit for two very different audiences gives the pitch broad, genuine appeal.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a personalised sports nutrition service building custom supplement formulas around individual training goals.
quests.correctAnswer: Your formula is built from your training load and your goals, not a generic tub off a shelf built for no one in particular.
quests.hint: Contrast custom formulation with an off-the-shelf product.
quests.explanation: Contrasting personal formulation with a generic product is strong differentiation in an otherwise crowded market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription box that sends age-appropriate conversation-starter cards for family dinners.
quests.correctAnswer: One card, one question, and suddenly dinner conversation flows without a single 'fine, nothing happened' from anyone at the table.
quests.hint: Name the exact flat answer this product prevents.
quests.explanation: Naming a familiar, slightly funny frustration makes a simple card deck feel worth trying tonight.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a corporate catering service using entirely whole-food, plant-based menus.
quests.correctAnswer: Lunch stops causing the afternoon slump - our whole-food menus fuel focus instead of the usual post-lunch crash.
quests.hint: Lead with the productivity angle, not the ingredients list.
quests.explanation: Linking food quality to afternoon performance turns catering into a business investment, not just a cost to cut.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a restaurant hygiene app that shows real-time safety scores before a diner chooses where to eat.
quests.correctAnswer: Check the live hygiene score before you sit down, so the decision is made with real information, not just a guess from the window display.
quests.hint: Lead with the moment before choosing, not after.
quests.explanation: Putting real information in front of a diner right before the decision shifts real power into their hands.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI interview-practice tool that gives job seekers feedback on tone, pacing, and clarity.
quests.correctAnswer: Practise the real questions and get honest feedback on your pace and tone, so the actual interview feels like the second time, not the first.
quests.hint: Focus on the confidence of a familiar second attempt.
quests.explanation: Feeling like you've already done it once is one of the most effective ways to calm interview nerves.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI camera for commercial kitchens that flags allergen cross-contamination before a dish leaves the pass.
quests.correctAnswer: It checks every dish for allergen cross-contamination before it ever leaves the kitchen - a safety net that runs quietly before anyone is ever put at risk.
quests.hint: Lead with prevention happening before any harm.
quests.explanation: Catching a risk before service, rather than after a complaint, is a genuine life-safety improvement in busy kitchens.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home fermentation kit with a guided app that guarantees a beginner's first batch works.
quests.correctAnswer: Every step is guided, so your very first batch of kombucha turns out right - no wasted ingredients, no second-guessing.
quests.hint: Lead with the guaranteed success of the first attempt.
quests.explanation: Guaranteeing early success removes the fear of wasted effort that keeps most beginners from ever starting.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a language-learning app for grandparents that teaches just enough of a grandchild's second language to connect.
quests.correctAnswer: Learn just enough of your grandchild's other language to finally understand their favourite jokes, not to pass any exam.
quests.hint: Lead with the emotional goal, not fluency as a skill.
quests.explanation: Reframing the goal as connection, not fluency, makes learning feel personal instead of like homework.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a live probiotic yoghurt delivery service that keeps the cold chain unbroken from farm to door.
quests.correctAnswer: The cold chain never breaks, so every spoonful carries more live cultures than anything that's spent a week on a supermarket shelf.
quests.hint: Lead with the cold chain as the technical difference.
quests.explanation: An unbroken cold chain is a concrete technical difference that a supermarket alternative simply cannot claim.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a plant-based meat alternative using precision fermentation to mimic specific cuts of meat.
quests.correctAnswer: Close your eyes, and you genuinely couldn't tell - the flavour and texture of the real cut, built entirely from plants.
quests.hint: Lead with the indistinguishable taste claim.
quests.explanation: Claiming sensory indistinguishability is the strongest possible reassurance for anyone sceptical of plant-based meat.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a neighbourhood app that matches spare house keys with trusted local pet or plant sitters.
quests.correctAnswer: Trade a spare key for peace of mind - a trusted neighbour waters your plants while you're away, no favour owed.
quests.hint: Frame it as neighbours helping neighbours, not a formal service.
quests.explanation: Framing the app around neighbourly trust, rather than a transaction, makes it feel warm and low-risk.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a whole-plant food brand that turns vegetable parts usually thrown away into snacks worth eating.
quests.correctAnswer: Broccoli stems become pasta, and watermelon rind becomes crisps - the parts you used to bin are now the best bit.
quests.hint: Use specific, surprising examples to make the idea concrete.
quests.explanation: Specific, unexpected examples create intrigue that a general 'we reduce waste' claim never quite manages.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an energy drink made with only natural caffeine sources and no sugar crash afterward.
quests.correctAnswer: Green tea and guarana give you the lift, without the sugar crash every standard energy drink leaves behind an hour later.
quests.hint: Use the direct competitor contrast explicitly.
quests.explanation: A direct contrast with the familiar sugar crash is compelling for anyone who has felt it before.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home organisation app that tells you exactly which drawer or box an item is stored in.
quests.correctAnswer: Type what you're looking for, and it tells you the exact box - no more emptying three cupboards to find one charger.
quests.hint: Picture the exact frustrating search this replaces.
quests.explanation: A precise, relatable scenario makes an otherwise dry organisation tool feel genuinely satisfying to use.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that delivers a new short story matched to your commute length every week.
quests.correctAnswer: Pick your commute time, and a story arrives that fits it exactly - finished before you even reach your stop.
quests.hint: Lead with the perfect fit to commute length.
quests.explanation: Matching content length to a real daily window removes the 'I never finish anything' excuse people often have.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a food discovery platform that tracks social media trends to surface emerging cuisines early.
quests.correctAnswer: It tracks food trends worldwide and brings the next big cuisine to your city before anyone else has even heard of it.
quests.hint: Lead with being first, not just being informed.
quests.explanation: Being first to a trend is a powerful motivator for the food-obsessed early adopters this app targets.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a remote-work scheduling tool that finds the one meeting time that actually suits every time zone.
quests.correctAnswer: It scans every teammate's time zone and finds the one slot that isn't unfair to somebody - no more 6am calls for one poor soul.
quests.hint: Name the specific unfairness this tool prevents.
quests.explanation: Naming a specific unfairness - an early call for one person - makes a scheduling tool feel considerate, not just efficient.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI chef tool that invents new recipes by blending two different cultural culinary traditions.
quests.correctAnswer: It blends two culinary traditions into one genuinely new recipe, honouring both instead of flattening them into something bland.
quests.hint: Lead with respectful fusion, not novelty for its own sake.
quests.explanation: Framing fusion as respectful rather than gimmicky gives the pitch a more thoughtful, memorable edge.
